note: One reading per non-read site of a declared (or withheld) end, keyed by revision-independent text. `keeps`: whether the site keeps the per-end claim (> 0: live; <= 0: absent or descriptor 0); `outside`: no cell.

calloc's zero bytes: every end holds 0, its absent value and also descriptor 0's number; no end is live yet. A `> 0` sentinel reads 0 as absent-or-descriptor-0, so the per-end claim holds
